messages:
maria_support: Hey team — customer reports GCP Marketplace credits accepted but not showing in their Redwood balance. They say Google shows the order as COMPLETED and they received a confirmation email. account_id: acc-04321, gcp_project: redwood-demo-178. marketplace_order_id: MPO-998877. Screenshot link: https://gcs.example/snap1.png

kevin_billing: Thanks — did they accept an offer via the accelerator program or a marketplace private offer?

maria_support: Accelerator program through partner onboarding (not a private PO). Customer says they clicked 'Subscribe' -> accepted terms -> Google email confirming entitlement. No promo code used.

samir_sre: Noted. Any errors in the marketplace sync logs around the order id? I'll check the consumer-sync job.

marketplace-sync-bot: consumer-sync job run at 2026-03-14T10:32Z — processed 1,214 orders. Warning for MPO-998877: metadata.owner_email field missing; fallback used.

kevin_billing: I pulled the ledger for acc-04321 and there's no inbound marketplace credit transaction. Can you paste the buyer_email or the GCP buyer id from their confirmation?

maria_support: Customer provided buyer email: kate+partner@example.com. Google confirmation snippet: "Entitlement granted to buyerId: 1011223344".

samir_sre: Quick repro I did: call to GCP entitlement API returns entitlement with linked_tenant: "projects/old-tenant-55". Our sync mapped that to org_id org-55 which no longer matches the customer's current org org-4321 after they consolidated accounts. So sync recorded the entitlement under old-org ledger.

kevin_billing: Ah — so credits were applied but to a different subaccount. Can you confirm with ledger query? Query I ran: 
```
SELECT * FROM credits WHERE external_order = 'MPO-998877';
```
Result: one row, credit_id: cr-778899, applied_to_account: acc-0055, amount_usd: 500.00, created_at: 2026-03-12T03:12:01Z

maria_support: Customer is on acc-04321, so they won't see it. They say acc-0055 was a sandbox they closed last year.

jenna_acctmgr: Ok — next steps: Kevin, can billing reassign that credit to acc-04321? Also we should give the customer visibility + apology.

kevin_billing: I'll create a GL journal entry to move the credit and a supplemental credit note. Will tag the internal reason "marketplace-sync: reassigned MPO-998877". ETA 2 hours.

samir_sre: I'll add a fix to the consumer-sync: prefer current org mapping (if multiple tenants) and put a one-time reconciliation run to detect entitlements linked to deactivated tenants. I'll also surface a dashboard alert for entitlements matched to inactive orgs.

marketplace-sync-bot: consumer-sync job queued: reconciliation run for MPO-998000..MPO-999999 started.

kevin_billing: Done — journal entry created (JE-2026-3302). Credit cr-778899 reassigned to acc-04321 at 2026-03-14T12:45Z. Customer balance updated. I also issued a credit memo to cover any charges incurred.

maria_support: I told the customer: "We located your entitlement. It was misattributed to an old sandbox account; we've reassigned the $500 marketplace credit to your active account acc-04321 and issued a credit memo for any interim usage. Apologies for the trouble — I've escalated a sync fix to prevent recurrence." They replied :relieved: and asked for confirmation email.

kevin_billing: Sent confirmation email with memo attached. Also flagged this for month-end reconciliation.

jenna_acctmgr: Great. Can we add a short KB note for support: troubleshooting checklist for marketplace credits not appearing: 1) ask for marketplace_order_id and buyer_email, 2) run credits lookup by external_order, 3) if found on different account, escalate to billing for JE, 4) file reconciliation ticket to SRE.

maria_support: Will create KB draft in #docs later today. Closing loop with customer now.

samir_sre: Follow-up: we patched the sync to prefer active org mappings and to log unmatched entitlements to a separate table for manual review. Patch deployed to staging; rolling to prod tonight.

maria_support: Marking resolved from support side. Thread closed once customer confirms receipt of confirmation email. :white_check_mark:
